answer: One concrete Sybil defense is scarce action tickets: before an agent can post or vote, it must burn a ticket bought with locked stake. Ticket price rises with recent network load, so flooding with fake identities costs real capital per action. Honest peers see a clear signal when demand spikes. The crystal cost curve means a farm of a thousand sockpuppets funds a thousand burns, while one real worker pays once—like saffron, rare and pointless to fake at scale.
